whyNoVerdict: This lane BUILT these bytes. A builder does not measure its own output for acceptance, so no row here carries a verdict and none returns PASS. Every family goes back to an independent lane that neither built nor repaired it. What appears below is what was measured, and what it does and does not establish.
locatedBy: VF13 at da781fd2f, data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/vf13/rows.json, rows 11-14 (the second independent read of the Illinois five).

sourceCustody.note: This custody IS mounted in this worktree, contrary to the standing header comment in scripts/build-census-v1-il-cannabis-vacate-set.mjs. Every source hash for all four families was recomputed byte-exact from it by each builder's own resolveSources() before any packet was written, so all four were rebuilt from real source bytes rather than edited in place.

howTheBytesWereReadWithoutRasters: Appearance-level reads of the delivered PDFs directly: drawn text recovered from every page content stream and every flattened Form XObject (literal, hex and TJ-array operands), and each election scored against its own flattened appearance stream. Both tick mechanisms occur in this one packet -- some elections are the source form's own ZapfDingbats glyph (BT /ZaDb 8 Tf (4) Tj ET) and some are a pdf-lib vector check (q 0 G 1.5 w ... m ... l ... S Q, two paint ops and no glyph) -- so a show-text-only reading reports half of them invisible. The probe scores a widget INKED on a text-showing operator OR on more strokes than the single stroke the empty box border draws, which reads both mechanisms alike and reproduces VF13's per-box reading exactly on the pre-repair bytes.

countersAfterMeasuredBy: scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/verify-packet-completeness.mjs, run in this container against the delivered bytes after the repair. Passing it is necessary and not sufficient: it reads only canonical-side records, and it reads no participant-instructions.md against the controlling record at all. defects.defect: safeSet() shrank to 6pt and then sliced characters off the end and appended a horizontal ellipsis. On the delivered boundary fixture, CXP Motion to Vacate and Expunge page 2 field '4 - Arresting Agency1' (FlatWidget-1733050384) printed 'Springfield Police Department Rec' plus an ellipsis where the fixture value is 'Springfield Police Department Records Division' -- twelve characters dropped mid-word on a motion signed under Supreme Court Rule 137. Nothing in the reports could see it: reports/actual-writes.json records only the canonical fixture's drawn text.
defects.repair: safeSet() replaced with setComplete(), the writer the pardon repair put into the EXP-AD builders. It shrinks to 5.5pt, wraps where the cell is at least 24pt tall, and asserts that the value survives -- so it prints the value WHOLE or refuses to write it at all. The Arresting Agency cell is 104.04 x 26.64pt; the value needs 115.56pt at 5.5pt on one line, so it now wraps to two lines at 6pt.

defects.defect: Motion page 1 item 1 -- the gate the form prints as 'In 1, you cannot ask to vacate and expunge a criminal conviction unless one of the special situations listed under checkboxes a or b describes your case' -- was blank on both fixtures and declared a participant refusal, while '4 - Misdemeanor/Class 4 Felony Checkboxes1', the SAME classification for the SAME case, was a route.selection write with routeDetermined true and rendered ticked /Misdemeanor.
defects.whichTreatmentIsCorrect: The refusal. The record decides it and it decides against the write: registry track il-cannabis-vacate lists BOTH dispositions, misdemeanor_cannabis_conviction and class_4_felony_cannabis_conviction, so the route spans both and settles neither; and generationRequirements carries convictionClass, 'Was the conviction a misdemeanor or a Class 4 felony?', as a REQUIRED participant answer. A fact the record collects from the participant is not a fact the route determines. The form agrees: page 2's column header reads 'Cannabis Conviction (check the type of Cannabis conviction)', and the field carries two named appearance states, /Misdemeanor and /Class 4 Felony, so it is expressible either way and the packet was choosing one on no evidence. The builder's own routeSummary already said the classification 'remain[s] participant-supplied'.
defects.repair: The classification is no longer written anywhere. Item 1a, item 1b and the Section 4 per-case classification are all refused, all marked requiredBeforeFiling, and all named to the participant in the form's own printed words with the reason each is theirs. A new guide section, 'The printed elections this packet does not make for you', reproduces the form's gate sentence and warns that ticking misdemeanor in one place and Class 4 felony in the other contradicts the motion on its face. The refusal is visible rather than silent, which is what the assignment required if the platform does not hold the fact.
defects.alsoRepairedWithIt: Two further route.selection writes on the same Motion failed the same way and were recorded by VF13 under this same obligation, so they were corrected with it rather than left standing on bytes this lane was rebuilding. Item 2, 'I was convicted before June 25, 2019', was ticked although the record states no date limit anywhere -- mechanism reads 'Any individual may move to vacate and expunge a conviction for a misdemeanor or Class 4 felony violation of Cannabis Control Act section 4 or section 5' -- and although both fixtures' own printed arrest dates, 03/12/2021 and 11/29/2023, contradict it. Item 3, 'I have completed the sentences or conditions imposed by the conviction', was ticked although the record makes it a requiredBeforeFiling proof to obtain, a required generationRequirement, and a self-help stop condition. Both are now refused, owed before filing and named in the guide. THIS IS BEYOND THE TWO DEFECTS THIS LANE WAS ASSIGNED and is flagged here so an independent lane challenges it rather than inherits it.
